hints.title: Diagonal Traversal
hints.text: Traverse diagonal rays upward-left and downward-right from each cell.

hints.title: Distinct Value Tracking
hints.text: Store the visited numbers in sets to measure the unique counts in both directions.

hints.title: Absolute Difference
hints.text: Take the absolute difference between the two set sizes for each position.

hints.title: Matrix Diagonal Traversal
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def differenceOfDistinctValues(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        ans = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        for r in range(m):
            for c in range(n):
                top_left = set()
                cr, cc = r - 1, c - 1
                while cr >= 0 and cc >= 0:
                    top_left.add(grid[cr][cc])
                    cr -= 1
                    cc -= 1
                bottom_right = set()
                cr, cc = r + 1, c + 1
                while cr < m and cc < n:
                    bottom_right.add(grid[cr][cc])
                    cr += 1
                    cc += 1
                ans[r][c] = abs(len(top_left) - len(bottom_right))
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Diagonal traversal per cell bounds each query to diagonal length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full matrix rescans would exceed constraints; stepping strictly along diagonals is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set tracks visited values during ray extension.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accurately navigates matrix bounds and computes set cardinalities.
